skill.displayName: Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper

version.changelog:
- Updated documentation in README.md and README.zh-CN.md for improved clarity.
- Revised and expanded references/requirement-plan.md for more detailed planning and evidence tracking.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file to streamline documentation.

llm.summary: This is a non-executable workflow helper, but it is set up to auto-activate on very broad everyday terms.

dimensions.detail: The instructions favor local, CPU-friendly scripts, templates, checklists, and analysis, with no requirement to read credentials, index private files, or call external services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation plus a small YAML agent metadata file; no installer, executable script, package hook, or runtime dependency was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares broad activation terms such as security, every, must, pass, and before, and agents/openai.yaml enables implicit invocation, making unintended activation materially likely.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, or credential/session handling was found; the concern is limited to broad implicit routing authority.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a SkillScan-style workflow/checklist helper for security and reliability tasks, and the artifacts only provide instructions and documentation rather than executable code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing in environments that auto-select skills. It should be narrowed to explicit SkillScan/security-workflow requests or have implicit invocation disabled so ordinary security, workflow, or bug-fix prompts are not routed through it unexpectedly.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad-trigger concern is supported by SKILL.md, README files, requirement-plan.md, and agents/openai.yaml; broad implicit activation is not necessary for this workflow-helper purpose, though no malicious payload or data access was found.
